subject: The 2AM mistake that changed everything
preview_text: One user's story stopped our team cold. See how a midnight slip-up led to a breakthrough for her dog.
body_paragraphs: Two weeks ago, Sarah from Ohio sent us a panicked message at 2AM. She'd accidentally double-fed her golden retriever, Max, a full day's worth of treats. "I felt like the worst dog mom alive," she wrote. Our team read it in silence — we've all been there.

But here's what happened next. Instead of giving up, Sarah opened PupShape and logged the mistake. The app recalculated Max's meal plan for the next two days, adjusted his exercise goals, and showed her a simple path to get back on track. Within 48 hours, Max was back to his healthy routine. Sarah told us, "I finally felt like I had a partner, not just a plan."

That's the power of our custom meal plan. It's built to handle real life — the slip-ups, the guilt, the chaos. Whether you over-treat, skip a walk, or face a holiday binge, the app adapts in seconds. No judgment, just science. And Sarah's not alone: over 110 dogs are using this feature right now.

Open PupShape: Dog Weight Loss Plan and log one meal or treat tonight. See how the plan adjusts for you. P.S. Sarah's before-and-after photos just hit our timeline — Max lost 14% in 6 weeks. Yours could be next.
